## {.archive-slide background-image="slides/02.webp" background-size="contain" background-color="#14140f"}

```{=html}
<div class="archive-text">Indiana WIDA-ACCESS Data
• Received data from Indiana DOE on June 17th.
• Prepared and ran analyses on data June 17th-June 18th.
• Results presented herein are preliminary (and based upon
preliminary data) but “check out” based upon comparisons with two
other states we have already received WIDA-ACCESS data from.

Understanding Indiana WIDA-ACCESS Pandemic Related Academic Impact</div>
```

## {.archive-slide background-image="slides/03.webp" background-size="contain" background-color="#14140f"}

```{=html}
<div class="archive-text">Participation
• We are still looking at this and may need some help with regard
to historical data.
• 2020 and 2021 data included almost all students with scale scores.
• 2021 data include approximately 100 students across all grades
without scaled scores
• Overall counts with scale scores did, in general decrease from 2020
to 2021.
• This could be due to lower participation (given that we don’t have missing
data in our file).
• This could be due to lower enrollment for this population.

Understanding Indiana WIDA-ACCESS Pandemic Related Academic Impact</div>
```

## {.archive-slide background-image="slides/05.webp" background-size="contain" background-color="#14140f"}

```{=html}
<div class="archive-text">Academic impact
• Initial analyses indicate substantial to moderate academic impact
in grades 1 to 6, moderate impact in grades 7 to 9, and no impact
or gains in grade 10 to 12.
• These results follow the same pattern seen in the two other states
examined thus far. Indiana faring a little better.
• Results in higher grades should be viewed with caution.
• Results in higher grades are likely indicative of how poorly these students
have grown historical as opposed to how well they were instructed over
the course of the pandemic.
• ELL students in higher grades tend to be long term ELLs who have failed to
transition out (as opposed to newly entering ELLs).
Understanding Indiana WIDA-ACCESS Pandemic Related Academic Impact</div>
```
